name: Shrek For Five Minutes
look: Two stacked stills of Shrek and Donkey. Top: Shrek leans through a torn hole in a pale cloth wall, frowning with his mouth open in annoyance. Bottom: Donkey stands outside the hole while Shrek, seen from the side, fires glowing red laser beams from his eyes at him.
use: Shrek wants a moment of peace and Donkey is the pest who will not allow it. The caption sets up the request or the interruption, Donkey is labeled as the annoyance, and the laser eyes show patience running out.
slots: top panel: what Shrek wants or the setup
bottom panel: the annoying interruption, labeling Donkey
examples: Me finally sitting down after a long day
Me trying to sleep in on Saturday
The neighbor's leaf blower at 7 a.m.
